```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(mgcv)
source("scripts/utils/data_loader.R")
source("scripts/utils/feature_engineering.R")
core <- load_core_data(getwd())
model_df <- build_modelling_dataset(core$policies, core$exposures, core$claims)
split <- split_train_test(model_df)
```

## GAM Tweedie Fit

```{r}
gam_fit <- mgcv::gam(
  total_loss ~ s(payroll) + s(employees) + s(years_in_business) + s(prior_claims) + naics_code + state + offset(log(pmax(exposure, 1e-4))),
  family = mgcv::tw(link = "log"),
  data = as.data.frame(split$train)
)
summary(gam_fit)
```
